# AlertDialog
Atlas AlertDialog — confirmation-only modal: title, description, Cancel/Action footer. No close-X, no dismiss by clicking outside; the user must choose an action. Escape still closes it, same as Dialog. Use for a decision that must be made, especially destructive/irreversible ones. For a message needing no decision use Alert; for general modal content with an optional close use Dialog.
